capacity_law.rule: Settlement population support is constrained by constructed housing, water, sanitation, food/storage/distribution, work access, security and transport. Capacity is a mutable physical property, never an arbitrary world or population cap.
capacity_law.damage_rule: Damage may reduce individual physical systems and therefore effective support before repairs restore them.
capacity_law.project_rule: Projects add or repair specific physical works using the existing funded project/material/labor system; silver alone never materializes completed infrastructure.

sword_manor.capacity_rule: No fixed trainee or total-personnel cap exists. Current trainee vacancies derive from dormitory beds plus shared institution support after housing existing higher ranks; practical intake throughput derives from assessment/induction facilities and available conserved applicants.

bastion_training.capacity_rule: Concurrent physical trainee places constrain how many people can train at once. They are not Corps-strength caps and can be expanded through physical infrastructure projects.

productive_assets.rule: These are physical-condition multipliers for the current constructed Tang Manor productive system. Damage changes them; they are not abstract upgrade levels or legal capacity caps.
